review_gates.name: phi-data-review
review_gates.description: Review for Protected Health Information (PHI) handling — encryption, access controls, minimum necessary principle

review_gates.name: security-review
review_gates.description: Security review for all code touching patient data, authentication, or data transmission

review_gates.name: hipaa-safeguards-review
review_gates.description: Verify technical safeguards: unique user ID, automatic logoff, encryption/decryption, audit controls

review_gates.name: breach-risk-assessment
review_gates.description: Assess breach risk for any new PHI data flows or storage patterns

governance.notes: HIPAA Technical Safeguards (45 CFR 164.312) apply. PHI must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Minimum necessary standard: only access the PHI needed for the task. Business Associate Agreements required for all third-party services touching PHI.
